issues.description: The paper does not provide a clear and specific definition of the term 'plain majority voting' in the context of the aggregation methods. This could lead to confusion for readers.
issues.suggestion: Define 'plain majority voting' explicitly in the introduction or the relevant section to ensure clarity.

issues.description: The phrase 'A synthetic pilot (4,000 trials per cell, N=7 verifiers, f=2 captured) already tests the prediction' is somewhat vague. It would be clearer to specify the exact conditions and results.
issues.suggestion: Provide more details on the exact conditions and results of the synthetic pilot in the abstract.

issues.description: The phrase 'A descriptive local-model pilot is included in the evidence package, but a held-out real-trace benchmark remains future work' could be more precise.
issues.suggestion: Clarify the status and availability of the local-model pilot and real-trace benchmark in the abstract.

novelty.overall_assessment: The paper provides a valuable empirical study on the limitations of aggregation methods in the context of verifier capture. However, it lacks a clear definition of 'plain majority voting' and could benefit from more precise descriptions in the abstract.
